Devon: quick pass on high-contrast mode + shortcuts overlay accessibility from this morning. found a few behavior/copy issues. posting notes so we can decide fixes. :mag:
Priya: thanks 10 — curious what stood out.
Devon: main things:
- when high-contrast theme is enabled, our shortcut modal (Cmd+/ overlay) uses a semi-transparent backdrop that still shows underlying content; SR users get confusing context because the modal doesn't set aria-hidden on the rest of the app.
- some shortcut labels use icon-only buttons (e.g., toggle dev toolbar) with title="" but no aria-label, so NVDA reads "button" only.
- the overlay's close button reads "Dismiss" in screen reader due to localization key mixup 12 — should be "Close shortcuts" for context.
- contrast-bot flagged keyboard hint tokens (e.g., keycaps) have insufficient contrast in HC: white on #f2f2f2 is 2.6:1.
- focus order: opening overlay focuses first shortcut row, but shift-tab doesn't return focus to the keyboard shortcut trigger (Cmd+/), so keyboard users can be trapped if they try to close with shift+tab.
Ava: ouch. repro steps? I can run VoiceOver quickly.
Devon: repro: enable high-contrast in profile > press Cmd+/ to open overlay > try hitting shift+tab from the first focusable item. Also turn on screen reader. overlay markup: <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true"> but we forgot to set aria-hidden=true on the main app wrapper. aria-bot: note: aria-modal on dialog is supported but many browsers don't prevent SR from navigating background nodes; adding aria-hidden on siblings recommended.
aria-bot: suggestion: add aria-hidden="true" to #app-content when dialog open, ensure focus trap util moves focus back to trigger on close.
Priya: for copy: good catch on the close label. we should use the pattern: <button aria-label="Close keyboard shortcuts">Close</button> and keep visible text minimal. Also prefer explicit aria-describedby linking to the list summary for screen reader context.
contrast-bot: auto-check: keycap token (white on #f2f2f2) -> 2.62:1 (fail AA). Suggested swap: keycap-bg #e2e2e2 or keycap-text #111827 to reach 4.5:1.
QA-Miguel: I'll add this to the HC test matrix. can we add acceptance criteria so we don't miss anything in the PR?
Devon: acceptance criteria (for PR):
- when overlay open, #app-content has aria-hidden="true" and is removed on close
- dialog role="dialog" with aria-modal="true" and aria-label="Keyboard shortcuts"
- close button has aria-label="Close keyboard shortcuts" and visible text kept short
- icon-only shortcut buttons include aria-label with the full action (e.g., "Toggle developer toolbar")
- keycap token color updated so contrast >= 4.5:1 in high-contrast theme
- focus trap ensures shift+tab from first item returns focus to the overlay trigger and ESC closes overlay
Priya: small UX nit: update heading inside overlay from "Shortcuts" to "Keyboard shortcuts" 13 so SR context matches aria-label.
Ava: I'll take the aria-hidden + focus trap changes. Priya, can you own copy changes and token suggestion?
Priya: yep. I'll add token sample values and update i18n key for the close label.
Devon: Miguel, once patch is up can you run: VoiceOver (mac), NVDA, keyboard-only testing, and the HC contrast report? also include screenshot of computed styles for keycap token in both normal and HC themes.
QA-Miguel: on it. will file test run in the PR checklist.
Priya: one more: telemetry note 14 15 16 — when overlay opens, we log `ui.shortcuts.open` and include whether HC theme is active. please ensure no PII logged.
Devon: good flag. keep payload minimal.
Ava: thanks all. I'll open a small PR for the focus/aria changes and tag you. trying to keep changes scoped so merge is quick. :rocket:
Priya: adding copy + token PR shortly.
QA-Miguel: will start test plan. asking for review once both PRs exist.
Devon: thanks team!
